brief: Daily marketcolour note, mostly a reported recap. SPX +59bps to 7811 (9/11 sectors up), NDX +51bps, RTY +46bps; AI software +513bps while TMUS -13.3% on SPCX spectrum headlines. Flow was light into earnings (asset managers net sellers, HFs balanced) until a Thursday-Friday semis/AI selling wave tied to OpenAI revenue headlines, which continued despite a clarification. EPS preview argues a high headline bar masks weak breadth: consensus is +27% y/y (highest since 2021) but the median stock is only +9% (vs 14% in Q2), and last quarter's beat-reward was the smallest on record (35bps vs 95bps historically) despite a high beat rate. Mag7 positioning jumped from a June low of 14% of US exposure to a record 22%. HF leverage rose while net exposure dipped; Europe was the only region net bought, tech/comms were sold, industrials/discretionary bought. John Flood argues demand, bearish sentiment, low HF exposure, possible IPOs and strong earnings together support SPX reaching 8k. Goldman shifts OW equities (3m/12m) and OW bonds (12m), tactically preferring cash. Also: a datacenter-power basket call, EU real estate NTA cuts and rating changes, a TRYG upgrade to Neutral, and an unconfirmed ASML Korea price-hike report read as supportive of its services margin growth.
